notes: Adds UNO to the Card Lounge with the Qurio avatars, voice reactions, animated dealing, discards, penalties, reverses, UNO calls and winner celebrations. Classic 108-card rules include Wild Draw Four challenges, missed-UNO catches, two-player Reverse, no stacking and 500-point matches. Offline bots use the selected difficulty; live rooms support 2–10 players with private hands and persistent rounds. Includes an illustrated card design, detailed rule book, saved offline rounds, match history, Hide/Show controls and looped music with volume and mute.
